job.job_description:
Role - Analytics Agent Platform Specialist (Snowflake Cortex / Databricks)

Exp - 6 to 10 Yrs

Role - Permanent FTE

Company - Data Analytics & AI/ML MNC

Location - Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune

Mode - Hybrid (2-3 days from office weekly)




Mandatory skills: Snowflake (Cortex, Snowpark), Databricks, Agentic AI




JD :

- Must know Cortex analyst (Text to SQL) and knows Agentic AI with Snowflake

- Enable, harden, and scale analytics agents (Snowflake Cortex Analyst and Databricks Genie) so teams can safely and rapidly deliver trustworthy, productiongrade AIassisted analytics.




Key focus areas may include:




- Semantic modeling and metric definition

- Agent stability, guardrails, and reliability

- Pattern development and enablement to help teams learn and scale adoption over time
